name: mattkay02
description: Claude Code skills I build for my own workflow: UI evidence and review, mobile QA and CI, web performance, reliability sweeps and motion design. Each skill installs on its own.

plugins.name: codemagic-build
plugins.description: Starts a Codemagic build from the terminal, polls it to completion, and reports the result with artifact download links, so "ship a build and tell me when it lands" doesn't mean sitting on a browser tab for twenty minutes.

plugins.name: ui-walk
plugins.description: Drives the running app with Playwright through every surface and state of a feature (empty, mid-flow, success, collapsed/expanded), saving an ordered, numbered screenshot folder that reads like a story.

plugins.name: page-audit
plugins.description: Audits a UI surface across seven axes and returns a prioritized P1/P2/P3 punch list, verifying every finding against the actual code (file:line citations) before reporting it.

plugins.name: emulator-verify
plugins.description: Lets an agent confirm a Flutter app's UI on the Android emulator by driving it with adb input, capturing screenshots over adb, and reading them back with vision, so it checks its own work between turns instead of asking me to look.

plugins.name: lighthouse-audit
plugins.description: Runs Lighthouse against a production build, takes the median of several mobile runs (single runs are noisy), and turns the result into an actionable punch list (category scores, Core Web Vitals, the exact failing audits and the LCP phase breakdown), with before/after support.

plugins.name: phone-fit
plugins.description: Steps through every state of a page or flow at the sizes phones actually give it (Safari's address bar takes part of the screen) and measures what desktop checks miss: a sheet or card that has to scroll, a Next or Submit button off screen, labels landing on other content, and a page that keeps writing to the DOM every frame, the usual reason iPhone Safari lags or reloads.

plugins.name: screen-board
plugins.description: Builds a board of every screen and state in an app (errors, empty, offline, dialogs and sheets, not just routes) as one page read top to bottom: a pinned code per screen, what each is FOR and what good looks like, a large view with previous and next, two tables, and what isn't on it and why.

plugins.name: silent-failure-sweep
plugins.description: Hunts a codebase for failures that happen without anyone being told: capped AI calls whose stop reason is never checked, errors turned into empty results, background jobs with no failure handler that leave records stuck mid-state, counts that report the same problem every run without escalating, and limits applied quietly.

plugins.name: motion-sketchbook
plugins.description: Sketches a design as rendered films and stills before anything is built: several distinct options for a launch animation, store pictures or a run of social posts, drawn in Remotion from the product's real screens, type and marks, and shown side by side on one page to pick by watching.

plugins.name: mobile-store-release
plugins.description: Connects an app to App Store Connect and Google Play with its own dedicated API keys, checks the store pictures, uploads the listing, screenshots and creative assets, and runs a read-only pre-flight that lists what App Review or Play would block or reject before anything is submitted.
